metadata.description: A spellbook of AI skills for Claude Code — engineering docs, AWS cost auditing and per-service cost deep dives.

plugins.name: engineering-docs
plugins.description: Write the engineering documents nobody wants to start from a blank page — product requirements docs, blameless root cause analyses, and operational runbooks. Each skill interviews you for what is missing, mines the repo and git history for what it can answer itself, and writes a finished Markdown document.

plugins.name: aws-cost-audit
plugins.description: Audit an AWS account for wasted spend, then go deeper on the two services that usually hide it. The sweep pulls Cost Explorer trends, finds idle and orphaned resources and S3 lifecycle gaps; the Glue deep dive attributes DPU-hours to individual jobs and reconciles them against the bill; the SageMaker deep dive attributes Studio spend to spaces, their owners and the notebooks that ran. Each writes a report or a self-contained HTML dashboard, and ships a deidentified example of one. Least-privilege IAM role included. Every AWS call is read-only.
